description_en: Queries the billing details of burstable clean bandwidth
description_zh: 查询弹性业务带宽的账单详情
name: DescribeSystemLog

parameters.help_en:
The type of system logs to query. The value is fixed at 20, which indicates the billing logs of burstable clean bandwidth.

You must set this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的系统日志的类型。取值固定为20，表示弹性业务带宽出账日志。

必须设置该参数，否则会调用失败
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91490.html to query the IP addresses of Anti-DDoS instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91490.html查询DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: entity_object

parameters.help_en: The start time to query bills of burstable clean bandwidth that are generated after the specified time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置起始时间，查询在该起始时间后出账的弹性业务带宽账单。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time to query bills of burstable clean bandwidth that are generated before the specified time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 设置结束时间，查询在该结束时间前出账的弹性业务带宽账单。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of logs to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含日志的数量
parameters.name: page_size

SystemLog.description_en: The details of the billing logs for burstable clean bandwidth
SystemLog.description_zh: 弹性业务带宽出账日志的详情列表

EntityObject.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance

EntityType.description_en: The type of the system log. The value is fixed at 20, which indicates the billing log of burstable clean bandwidth
EntityType.description_zh: 系统日志的类型。取值固定为20，表示弹性业务带宽出账日志

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the bill was created. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 账单的创建时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the bill was last modified. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 账单最后一次被修改的时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

OpAccount.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the bill belongs
OpAccount.description_zh: 账单所属阿里云账号的ID

OpAction.description_en: The operation type. The value is fixed at 100, which indicates that a billing record for burstable clean bandwidth is added
OpAction.description_zh: 操作类型。取值固定为100，表示新增弹性业务带宽出账记录

OpDesc.description_en:
The details of the bill. This value is a string that is converted from a JSON struct. The JSON struct contains the following fields:

newEntity: Object type, which indicates the bill record and contains the following fields:

billValue: Integer type | The usage of burstable clean bandwidth in the billing month. Unit: Mbit/s.
instanceId: String type | The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance.
ip: String type | The IP address of the Anti-DDoS instance.
maxBw: String type | The actual peak value of service traffic in the billing month (monthly 95th percentile). Unit: Mbit/s.
month: Long type | The month when the bill is generated (the billing month is the calendar month before the month when the bill is generated). This value is a timestamp in milliseconds.
overBandwidth: Integer type | The bandwidth that exceeds the clean bandwidth specification of the instance. Unit: Mbit/s.
peakTime: Long type | The time when the actual peak value of service traffic is measured. This value is a timestamp in seconds.
startTimestamp: Long type | The start time of the period when the peak value of instance service traffic is measured. This value is a timestamp in seconds
OpDesc.description_zh:
账单详情。使用JSON结构体转化的字符串表示，JSON结构体包含以下字段：

newEntity：Object类型，表示账单记录，具体包含以下字段：

    - billValue：Integer类型 | 计费月份的弹性业务带宽用量，单位：Mbps。
    - instanceId：String类型 | DDoS高防实例的ID。
    - ip：String类型 | DDoS高防实例的IP地址。
    - maxBw：String类型 | 计费月份的实际业务流量峰值（月95峰值），单位：Mbps。
    - month：Long类型 | 账单出具月份（计费月份为账单出具月份的上个自然月），使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。
    - overBandwidth：Integer类型 | 实际业务流量峰值超出实例业务带宽规格的带宽大小，单位：Mbps。
    - peakTime：Long类型 | 实际业务流量峰值的计量时刻，使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。
    - startTimestamp：Long类型 | 实例业务流量峰值区间的起始时刻，使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the bill. Valid values:

0: indicates that the bill is pending.
1: indicates that the bill is generated.
2: indicates that the bill is terminated
Status.description_zh:
账单的状态。取值：

0：表示待出账。
1：表示已出账。
2：表示终止出账

Total.description_en: The total number of billing logs for burstable clean bandwidth that are queried
Total.description_zh: 查询到的弹性业务带宽出账日志的总数量
